title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 181 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 181 - Prior Approval of the Inspecting Additional Commissioner of Taxes for Imposition of Penalty The Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall not impose any penalty under this Part without obtaining the prior approval of the Inspecting Additional Commissioner of Taxes except in the cases mentioned in sections 266, 275, 276, 277, 278 and 279. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
